newsitem.title: SPAIN: BCH, Gaz de France, Bufete in natgas bid.
newsitem.headline: BCH, Gaz de France, Bufete in natgas bid.

text.p: Spain's Banco Central Hispano (BCH) said on Thursday it will bid for a licence to distribute natural gas in Mexico together with Gaz de France and Bufete Industrial.
The licence will be the first of its kind in the Rio Panuco area, in which there is a population of 2.5 million people, BCH said.
BCH already has a stake in Mexican banking group Bital.
The bank did not specify how much the deal might be worth.
Bufete Industrial is a Mexican construction and engineering firm.

BCH noted that the towns of Tampico and Altamira within the area have significant ports at the north of the Mexico Gulf, as well as representing the biggest operating base for Mexico's oil and gas monopoly PEMEX.
